method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs
why_not_one_block_off: PRINTED NAME. The corridor I measured is lettered in its own roadway on both plates: 'AVE. G OR WINNIE' reads vertically inside the roadway at native x~1148 on sheet 61 (visible in view 1 at its east side and again in view 2 at its west side) and inside the roadway at native x~2166 on sheet 68 (view 2 east side, view 3 west side). HUNDRED-BLOCK BREAK. On BOTH sheets this corridor is the 600/700 break of the numbered-street addresses. Sheet 61: the block column immediately WEST of it carries 601 603 605 607 609 611 613 615 617 619 621 623 along 32ND ST and 602 604 ... 624 along 33RD ST, and the column immediately EAST of it carries 701 703 705 707 709 711 713 715 717 719 721 723 / 702 704 ... 724 (blocks 332 and 391/392). Sheet 68: the column WEST of it carries 601 603 ... 623 / 602 604 ... 624 along 33RD and 34TH ST (blocks 393, 394) and the column EAST of it carries 701 703 705 707 709 711 713 715 717 719 721 723 / 702 704 ... 724 (blocks 333, 334). Same 600-block on the west face, same 700-block on the east face, on both plates. ONE BLOCK WEST EXCLUDED. That corridor is separately lettered 'AVE. F OR CHURCH' on both plates (sheet 61 centre native 146.0, cut by the sheet's west border at x=17; sheet 68 centre native 1163.8, fully drawn in views 1 and 2) and it is the 500/600 break, not the 600/700 break - on sheet 68 the column west of it reads 501 503 ... 523 / 502 504 ... 524 (Galveston Brewing Co., blocks 453/454) while the column east of it reads 601 ... 623. ONE BLOCK EAST EXCLUDED. That corridor is lettered 'AVE. H OR BALL' on both plates (sheet 61 centre native 2155.9; sheet 68 centre native ~3169, clipped by the east border) and it is the 700/800 break - on sheet 61 the column east of Ave H reads 801 803 ... 823 / 802 804 ... 824 (blocks 271/272), i.e. the 700-block run lies BETWEEN Ave G and Ave H, so Ave H cannot be the 600/700 line. NEAR-EQUAL-NATIVE-X TRAP, EXPLICITLY REJECTED. These two plates are offset by very nearly one full block in native x, so matching by similar native x gives exactly the wrong answer. Measured avenue centres at mid-sheet: sheet 61 F=146.0, G=1148.2, H=2155.9, I=3155 (keymap F,G,H,I); sheet 68 E=~157, F=1163.8, G=2165.7, H=~3169 (keymap E,F,G,H). Sheet 61's Ave G (1148.2) sits within 16 px of sheet 68's Ave F (1163.8), and 61's Ave F (146.0) within 11 px of 68's Ave E - a naive equal-x match would pair WINNIE with CHURCH and shear the row by a full block. The printed lettering and the 600/700 versus 500/600 address runs are what decide it. CORROBORATION. The two independently measured lettered avenues that both sheets draw in full give the same plate-to-plate x shift: Ave G 2165.7-1148.2 = +1017.5 px and Ave F 1163.8-146.0 = +1017.8 px, agreeing to 0.3 px, where a one-block error would be about 1000 px. Drafted roadway width (facing block lines) is 211.1 native px on sheet 61 and 211.4 on sheet 68 = 68.7 ft, matching the 70' printed beside the avenue; the 20-ft mid-block alleys measure only ~57 native px (e.g. sheet 68 alley faces 2637/2693 between Ave G and Ave H, sheet 61 alley near 1877), so no alley was mistaken for the avenue. The sheets are confirmed stacked and correctly ordered: sheet 61's bottom margin prints '68' and sheet 68's top margin prints '61', and 33RD ST is the shared seam (bottom row of sheet 61, top row of sheet 68). NOTE ON THE CANDIDATES AND THE RED MARKER. None of the reported coordinates is a detection candidate. The red line in each crop is only the crop centre (native 832 / 1664 / 2495) and lands mid-block; the detection candidates (61: 398/1434/2470, 68: 1761/2778/744) likewise fall on mid-block lot and alley lines, not on lettered avenues. The reported values are roadway centrelines measured off the native pixel grid the green ruler labels. MEASUREMENT CONVENTION. Both plates carry a slight scan rotation (avenue centre drifts -0.0060 px/row on sheet 61 and +0.0032 to +0.0048 px/row on sheet 68), so each centreline was measured in seven y bands from y=600 to y=3400, fitted linearly and evaluated at the sheet's vertical mid-height y=1949. Reading instead in the band adjacent to the shared 33RD ST seam gives 61 G=1139.5 / 68 G=2160.6, a shift of +1021.1 rather than +1017.5; that 3.6 px is the honest uncertainty from the opposed tilts and is far below the one-block scale that matters here.
